adds.title: ILGA-Europe 2025 report
adds.summary: In February 2025 Poland's Supreme Court ruled that a non-binary casino dealer in Wroclaw dismissed in 2021 for refusing female appearance rules requiring make-up, skirts and high heels had suffered gender-based discrimination, the first explicit recognition under Polish law that non-binary persons can face gender discrimination; Penal Code amendments adopted by parliament in March 2025 and approved by the government in November 2024 to extend hate-crime and hate-speech protection to sexual orientation, gender, age and disability were referred to the Constitutional Tribunal by President Andrzej Duda in April 2025 and ruled unconstitutional on 30 September 2025, so the extended protections including gender never entered into force.
